Products.title: Core products
Products.subtitle: A modular, API-first stack to build any financial experience.

items.name: NovoCard
items.description: Start issuing credit, debit, and prepaid cards to your customers in record time and transform their experience.
items.differentiator: API-first architecture: launch a full card program in weeks, not months.
steps: Configure the program — define the brand (Visa, Mastercard, or closed loop), BIN, and rules via API.
Instant issuance — generate virtual and physical cards in minutes.
Real-time management — blocking, limits, tokenization, and monitoring from day one.

items.name: NovoCredit
items.description: Empower issuers and fintechs with a complete toolkit for loan management, automation, and servicing.
items.differentiator: A single end-to-end platform for consumer, business, auto, and mortgage credit.
steps: Origination — connected to underwriting and external decisioning engines.
Automated servicing — autopay, statements, and full loan lifecycle management.
Flexible collections — configurable payment plans and hardship programs.

items.name: NovoFlow
items.description: Build payment and correspondent networks that give your customers instant access and convenience.
items.differentiator: A single switch connects every participant in your network, with no point-to-point integrations.
steps: Connect your platform — integrate via APIs to NovoPayment's Banking Network.
Add correspondents — onboard banks and participants in a standardized way.
Process in real time — instant book-to-book transfers and inter-institution payments.

items.name: NovoFlux
items.description: A cloud-native payments switch that routes transactions dynamically, reliably, and securely.
items.differentiator: Cuts network connection time by up to 98% compared to legacy infrastructure.
steps: Direct cloud connection — no dedicated hardware, direct connection to Visa and Mastercard.
Dynamic routing — real-time authorization with low latency and high availability.
Switching + Issuing — process, authorize, and issue from a single cloud-native platform.

items.name: NovoSpend
items.description: Offer simplified expense management solutions to your corporate customers.
items.differentiator: Moves spend policy to the only moment it can actually be effective: the instant of authorization.
steps: Corporate funding — manage master accounts and sub-accounts for flexible fund allocation.
Card issuance — distribute physical or virtual cards, individually, in bulk, or unnamed.
Real-time spend controls — per card, employee, or program limits, and merchant category restrictions before authorization.
